item.title: Pocahontas Airport gets $1.6 million grant
item.description: The Pocahontas Airport will be receiving a grant for $1.6 million to renovate its runway. The project will include new pavement, runway markers, and paint. The tentative start date for the renovation project is April 1, 2026.
